questions.question: I had a hard time (a)/ paying the driver (b)/ as I had (c)/ only hundreds rupee note.(d)
questions.solutionHinglish:
Ans (d)
Explanation:- 'only hundreds rupee note' ki jagah inme se koi ek use karenge:
- only one hundred rupee note (Sirf ek 100 rupees ka note)
- only one hundred rupees (Sirf 100 rupees)
- only hundred rupee notes (Sirf 100-100 rupees wale note)

questions.question: When I was walking (a)/ along the bank of the river, (b)/ I saw an asleep man (c)/ in rags and tatters.(d)
questions.solutionHinglish:
Ans (c) Use 'I saw a man who was asleep' in place of 'I saw an asleep man'.
Explanation:- kyunki 'asleep' ek aisa adjective hai jo ki noun se pehle nahi lagaya jaata balki iska use predicatively yaani linking verb ke baad likh kar kiya jaata hai.

questions.question: Don't worry, (a)/ there is less time (b)/ for the train to arrive.(c)/ no error (d)
questions.solutionHinglish:
Ans (b) replace 'less' with 'some/enough/a little'
Explanation:- yahan koi comparison nahi ho raha isliye 'less' ka use nahi hoga. Sahi meaning ke liye 'some time', 'enough time', ya 'a little time' laga sakte hain.

questions.question: The food tasted deliciously (a)/ and all present in the party (b)/ enjoyed it to their full. (c)/ no error(d)
questions.solutionHinglish:
Ans (a) Use 'delicious' in place of 'deliciously'
Explanation:- kyunki 'taste' ek linking verb ki tarah se kaam kar rahi hai isliye uske baad koi adverb nahi balki adjective ('delicious') ka use kiya jayega.

questions.question: He lost (a)/ all his (b)/ hardly earned money. (c)/ no error (d)
questions.solutionHinglish:
Ans (c) use 'hard' instead of 'hardly'
Explanation:- 'Hardly' (naa ke barabar) aur 'Hard' (mehenat se/zor se), toh sahi meaning ke liye 'hard earned money' sahi hoga.

questions.question: Everything will be done (a)/ to bring (b)/ the responsible people to justice. (c)/ no error (d)
questions.solutionHinglish:
Ans (c) Use 'people responsible' in place of 'responsible people'.
Explanation:- 'responsible people' ka matlab jimmedar log aur 'people responsible' ka matlab 'log jo kisi cheez (crime/fault) ke liye jimmedar hain'. Isliye 'people responsible' sahi hoga.

questions.question: She ran so fastly (a)/ that I could (b)/ not overtake her.(c)/ no error (d)
questions.solutionHinglish:
Ans (a) use 'fast' instead of 'fastly'
Explanation:- kyunki 'fastly' koi word nahi hota, correct word 'fast' hota hai chahe adjective banana ho yaa adverb.

questions.question: Even today (a)/ it is incredulous to think (b)/ that men have walked on the moon.(c)/ no error (d)
questions.solutionHinglish:
Ans (b) Use 'incredible' in place of 'incredulous'.
Explanation:- 'incredible' = impossible or very difficult to believe; 'incredulous' = not willing or not able to believe something. Sentence ke meaning ke according 'incredible' sahi hoga.

questions.question: Platinum is (a)/ costlier than (b)/ any metal (c)/ found on earth.(d)
questions.solutionHinglish:
Ans (c) Replace 'any metal' with 'any other metal'
Explanation:- kyunki jab ek noun ka comparison ek aise group se karna hota hai jiska wo khud ek part hota hai toh usse 'other' lagakar exclude karna padta hai.

questions.question: A skilful advertiser may be able to create (a)/ practically a monopoly for himself (b)/ not because his product is superior to (c)/ but because he has succeeded in inducing people to believe that it is.(d)
questions.solutionHinglish:
Ans (c) Remove 'to' after 'superior'.
Explanation:- kyunki yahan 'to' preposition ke baad koi noun hi available nahi hai isliye yahan 'superior' ke baad 'to' ka use nahi hoga.

questions.question: Deepak said he would pack (a)/ few things he had (b)/ and vacate the hostel room (c)/ the next day.(d)
questions.solutionHinglish:
Ans (b) use 'the few' instead of 'few'
Explanation:- yahan meaning yeh hai ki wo apni thodi jitni cheezen hain wo pack karega. Whole quantity ke liye 'the few' ka use karte hain.

questions.question: Although the toys (a)/ are altogether (b)/ in the cupboard (c)/ they are not properly arranged.(d)
questions.solutionHinglish:
Ans (b) use 'all together' instead of 'altogether'
Explanation:- 'Altogether' ka matlab 'in total/completely', 'All together' ka matlab 'with each other' (ek sath), toh meaning ke according 'all together' sahi hoga.

questions.question: Scientists have found (a)/ that life was creeping and crawling about the Earth (b)/ 1.5 billion years early than (c)/ previously thought.(d)
questions.solutionHinglish:
Ans (c) use 'earlier' instead of 'early'
Explanation:- kyunki 'early' positive degree hoti hai aur yahan 'than' se pata chal raha ki comparison karna hai, isliye comparative degree 'earlier' ka use hoga.

questions.question: You should know (a)/ that the blind (b)/ leads a very difficult life. (c)/ no error (d)
questions.solutionHinglish:
Ans (c) replace 'leads' with 'lead'.
Explanation:- 'the blind' ka matlab hai saare blind people, 'the + adjective' common plural noun banata hai isliye inke sath plural verb ('lead') ka use kiya jaata hai.

questions.question: I will give you (a)/my notes if you promise (b)/to return the same by Sunday. (c)/ no error (d)
questions.solutionHinglish:
Ans (c) replace 'the same' with 'them'
Explanation:- 'the same' ka use adjective ke roop mein kiya jaata hai par hume yahan pronoun ('them') ki zarurat hai jo 'notes' noun ko refer karega.

questions.question: The photograph which (a)/ was taken by Rahul is (b)/ comparatively better than this one.(c)/ no error(d)
questions.solutionHinglish:
Ans (c) replace 'better' with 'good' (or remove 'comparatively')
Explanation:- 'comparatively' ke sath adjective ki positive degree aati hai ya 'better than' ke sath 'comparatively' hata diya jata hai.

questions.question: The stranger stood quietly for few moments.
questions.solutionHinglish:
Ans (d)
Explanation:- 'few' ka matlab (na ke barabar), 'the few' ka matlab (specific/particular) and 'a few' ka matlab (kuch). Yahan meaning ke according 'for a few moments' best option hai.

questions.question: We live in a populated country of 120 million people.
questions.solutionHinglish:
Ans (c)
Explanation:- 'Populous' (Adjective): wo area jahan bahut sare log rahte hai. Yahan country noun ke liye adjective 'populous' aayega.

questions.question: This package is ideal for infant teenager who are just getting started with babysitting.
questions.solutionHinglish:
Ans (c)
Explanation:- Infant teenager jaisa koi term possible hi nhi hai. Sentence mein teenagers ka kisi aur se comparison nahi hai isliye 'young teenagers' ka use hoga.

questions.question: Between Raima and Saima, the former is intelligent, while the latter is beautiful.
questions.solutionHinglish:
Ans (c)
Explanation:- latter = 2 cheezo mein se baad wala, later = fir kabhi/baad mein (time). Yahan meaning ke according 'latter is' sahi use hua hai.

questions.question: With tear eyes, she said goodbye to her dear friend.
questions.solutionHinglish:
Ans (a)
Explanation:- yahan eyes ke liye adjective chahiye. 'teary' adjective hota hai jiska matlab (filled with tears), toh sahi option 'teary eyes' hoga.

questions.question: The apple tree was loaded of fruit.
questions.solutionHinglish:
Ans (d)
Explanation:- Trees pe lage fruits ke liye and person pe emotion burden yaa responsibilities etc ke liye loaded nahi 'laden with' ka use hota hai.

questions.question:
Select the correct superlative degree of adjective for the given sentence.
The money arrived when I (little) expected it.
options: (a) The money arrived when I expected it.
(b) The money arrived when I least expected it.
(c) The money arrived when I less expected it.
(d) The money arrived when I little expected it
questions.solutionHinglish:
Ans (b)
Explanation:- Yahan little ki superlative degree likhni hai jo ki 'least' hoti hai. Isliye option B sahi hoga.

questions.question:
Select the correct superlative degree of comparison for the given sentence.
This is one of the beautiful places in the area.
options: (a) This is one of the most beautiful places in the area.
(b) This is one of the more beautiful places in the area.
(c) This is one of the beautiful places in the area.
(d) This is a beautiful place in the area.
questions.solutionHinglish:
Ans (a)
Explanation:- Yahan 'beautiful' ki superlative degree likhni hai jo ki 'most beautiful' hoti hai. Isliye option A sahi hoga.

questions.question:
Select the correct degree of comparison for the given sentence.
David looks (old) than he really is.
options: (a) David looks old than he really is.
(b) David looks older than he really is.
(c) David looks elder than he really is.
(d) David looks elder from he really is.
questions.solutionHinglish:
Ans (b)
Explanation:- Yahan 'old' ki comparative degree likhni hai jo ki 'older' hoti hai. Isliye option B sahi hoga.

questions.question: Gel ingredients work well on waved, curled, relax and texture hair in the long run.
questions.solutionHinglish:
Ans (a)
Explanation:- Yahan 'hair' noun ke liye adjective ka use karna hai. Parallelism and meaning ke according saare past participle form mein use hue hai, isliye 'relaxed and textured' option A sahi hai.

questions.question: It has been my great misfortune to follow a speech more notable for its volume than for any sense.
options: (c) to follow a speech much notable
(d) to have being following a speech more notable
questions.solutionHinglish:
Ans (b)
Explanation:- Yahan speech ki length and sense ka comparison hai isliye yahan comparative degree sahi lagi hai. Isliye option B 'No improvement required' sahi hoga.

questions.question: This is on far a best ice cream I have ever had.
questions.solutionHinglish:
Ans (a)
Explanation:- Superlative degree ki intensity badhane ke liye 'by far' ka use hota hai. Isliye 'by far the best' wala option A sahi hoga.

questions.question: Robin has less marbles than George.
questions.solutionHinglish:
Ans (d)
Explanation:- 'less' uncountable ke liye aata hai but marbles countable hai isliye 'fewer marbles' wala option D sahi hoga.

questions.question: One must care as for family members as possible.
questions.solutionHinglish:
Ans (d)
Explanation:- Simile ('as much ... as') mein positive degree ka hi use hota hai isliye 'as much for family members' sahi hai.

questions.question: This TV channel has a larger viewership from another channel.
questions.solutionHinglish:
Ans (b)
Explanation:- Comparative degree 'larger' ke baad 'than' ka use hoga aur channel ko group se exclude karne ke liye 'any other' ka use hoga. Isliye 'than any other channel' sahi hoga.

questions.question: This mango tree yields lot of mangoes every year.
questions.solutionHinglish:
Ans (a)
Explanation:- Yahan 'mangoes' ke liye quantitative adjective chahiye, isliye 'a lot of' ka use hoga.

questions.question: You must start your work without some farther delay.
questions.solutionHinglish:
Ans (b)
Explanation:- Yahan meaning dena hai 'bina koi bhi aur delay ke' isliye 'any further delay' ka use hoga.

questions.question: There is no need to make changes in many part of this sentence as it is grammatically correct.
questions.solutionHinglish:
Ans (c)
Explanation:- Sahi meaning yeh hoga ki 'kisi bhi part mein changes karne ki jarurat nahi hai', isliye 'in any part of' sahi hoga.

questions.question: Priya had strong enough to fight all odds and succeed in meeting her goals in life.
questions.solutionHinglish:
Ans (d)
Explanation:- Kisi person ki koi quality bataane ke liye generally 'Subject + linking verb + Adjective' structure ka use hota hai. Isliye 'was strong' ka use hoga.

questions.question: Children need much of guidance in how to use the internet wisely and efficiently.
questions.solutionHinglish:
Ans (c)
Explanation:- Yahan positive mein baat karni hai aur 'of' preposition bhi ek hint hai ki 'a lot of' ka use hoga. Isliye 'a lot' option C sahi hoga.

questions.question: You can find several kind of birds in the Mysore Zoo, Pelicans, Flamingos, Hornbills and Egrets.
questions.solutionHinglish:
Ans (a)
Explanation:- 'several' ke baad noun plural aata hai. Isliye 'several kinds of birds' wala option A sahi hoga.

questions.question: "Can you give me so many examples of subordinate clauses?", the teacher asked the class.
questions.solutionHinglish:
Ans (b)
Explanation:- Sentence ke meaning ke according teacher yahan students ko aur examples ke liye puch raha hai, isliye 'some more examples of' option B sahi hoga.

questions.question: Lenovo has launched ThinkPad XI Fold, the world's first foldable laptop which is claimed to be so durable as its other devices.
questions.solutionHinglish:
Ans (d)
Explanation:- Simile mein positive degree adjective ka use hota hai aur 'so...as' ka use sirf negative meaning ke liye hota hai. Isliye 'to be as durable as' option D sahi hoga.

questions.question: Rahul thinks that this is quite the cheap restaurant.
questions.solutionHinglish:
Ans (d)
Explanation:- Structure: quite + a/an + adjective + noun. Sentence mein emphasise karna hai isliye 'quite a cheap' ka use hoga.

questions.question: He spends good deal of money on clothing.
questions.solutionHinglish:
Ans (a)
Explanation:- 'a lot of' ki tarah 'a good deal of' phrase bhi quantity dikhaane ke liye use kiya jata hai. Isliye option A sahi hoga.

questions.question: The author is not well known. Little bit people have heard of him.
questions.solutionHinglish:
Ans (d)
Explanation:- 'people' countable noun hai aur 'Author well known nahi hai' matlab 'naa ke barabar' log jaante honge, isliye 'Few people' wala option D sahi hoga.

questions.question: My mother looked at Sana and me with her mouth slight openly.
questions.solutionHinglish:
Ans (d)
Explanation:- Yahan 'mouth' noun ko qualify karna hai isliye 'open' adjective ka use hoga aur 'open' adjective ke liye 'slightly' adverb ka. Isliye 'slightly open' sahi hoga.

questions.question: Water and minerals presented to the soil are absorbed by the roots.
questions.solutionHinglish:
Ans (c)
Explanation:- Yahan meaning ye dena hai ki 'water and minerals jo soil mein present hote hain', isliye adjective 'present in the soil' option C sahi hoga.

questions.question: Peterkin readjusted his hat and soon was listening to the conversation with as much interest as I was.
questions.solutionHinglish:
Ans (d)
Explanation:- 'Interest' uncountable noun hai isliye 'as much interest as' sahi use hua hai.

questions.question: It is much more difficult to judge oneself than to judge others.
questions.solutionHinglish:
Ans (d)
Explanation:- 'Much more difficult' sahi use hua hai. Isme 'difficult' adjective ke liye 'more' comparative degree bana rahi hai aur 'much' adverb 'more' ki intensity badhane ke liye aaya hai.

questions.question: There will be little more pupils in the class next year, but we have enough space.
questions.solutionHinglish:
Ans (b)
Explanation:- 'Pupils' countable noun hai aur 'kuch aur students honge next year' positive meaning ke liye 'a few more' wala option B sahi hoga.

questions.question: India have a many all-rounders to match the talent and dedication of Kapil Dev.
questions.solutionHinglish:
Ans (d)
Explanation:- 'India' singular hai aur 'all-rounders' countable plural noun hai, isliye grammar aur meaning ke according 'has few' option D hi sahi hai.

questions.question: Prithvi likes baseball as long as she likes cricket.
questions.solutionHinglish:
Ans (b)
Explanation:- 'likes' verb ke comparison ke liye simile mein adverb 'much' ka use hoga isliye 'as much as' sahi hai.

questions.question: When it started raining, I ran to the nearer house for shelter.
questions.solutionHinglish:
Ans (a)
Explanation:- Meaning and grammar ke according 'the nearest house' option A hi sahi hai.

questions.question: The less mistakes (a)/ you make in your calculations, (b)/ the more accurate your results will be. (c)/ No error (d)
questions.solutionHinglish:
Ans (a) replace 'less' with 'fewer'
Explanation:- Sentence mein 'less' ki jagah 'fewer' aayega kyunki 'mistakes' countable noun hai, isliye countable noun ke liye 'few' ke comparative degree 'fewer' ka use sahi hoga.

questions.question: The manager asked for (a)/ farther details (b)/ about the new marketing strategy (c)/ before approving it. (d)
questions.solutionHinglish:
Ans (b) replace 'farther' with 'further'
Explanation:- 'farther' ka use distance ko refer karne ke liye kiya jaata hai jabki 'further' ka use more/addition ko refer karne ke liye kiya jaata hai.

questions.question: The committee agreed that this design (a)/ was most unique (b)/ among all the innovative entries submitted for the annual architecture competition. (c)/ No error (d)
questions.solutionHinglish:
Ans (b) remove 'most' before 'unique'
Explanation:- Kuch adjectives jaise 'impossible, eternal, supreme, entire, circular, unique, perfect, excellent etc.' non-gradable hote hai, isliye yahan 'unique' se pehle 'most' nahi aayega.

questions.question: Of the four subjects, English, Mathematics, Science and History, (a)/ the latter (b)/ was the most difficult one for me. (c)/ No error (d)
questions.solutionHinglish:
Ans (b) replace 'latter' with 'last'
Explanation:- Jab do se jyada cheezein ho toh 'first, last' ka use karte hai. Sentence mein four subjects hai aur aakhiri subject ki baat karni hai, isliye 'last' sahi hoga.

questions.question: No less than twenty buses (a)/ were lined up outside the stadium (b)/ to carry the players and the officials (c)/ back to their hotels. (d)
questions.solutionHinglish:
Ans (a) replace 'no less than' with 'no fewer than'
Explanation:- 'twenty buses' countable noun hai, isliye yahan 'few' ki comparative degree 'fewer' ka use sahi hoga.

questions.question: The museum is (a)/ a worth visiting place (b)/ for those who are interested (c)/ in ancient sculptures. (d)
questions.solutionHinglish:
Ans (b) replace 'worth visiting place' with 'place worth visiting'
Explanation:- 'worth + ing' lagake adjective banate hai toh wo adjective humesha noun ('place') ke baad aata hai.

questions.question: Hard work, consistent practice, and (a)/ little guidance from (b)/ the mentor, especially in handling difficult situations, can (c)/ lead to great success in any field. (d)
questions.solutionHinglish:
Ans (b) replace 'little' with 'a little'
Explanation:- Sentence ke meaning ke according positive meaning ('thoda sa guidance') chaiye, isliye 'a little' sahi hoga.

questions.question: Her performance was (a)/ as exciting, if (b)/ not more than her previous one. (c)/ No error (d)
questions.solutionHinglish:
Ans (b) replace 'as exciting' with 'as exciting as'
Explanation:- 'as exciting as' yahan par ek simile hai jise poora hi likha jayega.

questions.question: This solution (a)/ is superior than the previous one (b)/ if we consider not only speed (c)/ but also cost-effectiveness and long-term sustainability. (d)
questions.solutionHinglish:
Ans (b) replace 'than' with 'to'
Explanation:- 'superior, inferior, prior, senior, preferable, anterior etc.' ke sath 'than' nahi balki 'to' preposition ka use hota hai.

questions.question: He wore (a)/ the dress very designed by (b)/ his talented elder sister (c)/ for the annual school function. (d)
questions.solutionHinglish:
Ans (b) replace 'dress very' with 'very dress'
Explanation:- 'very' stress dene ke liye adjective ki tarah se bhi kaam karta hai aur iska meaning 'same/wahi' jaisa hota hai, isliye 'very' ka use 'dress' se pehle hoga.

questions.question: Late at night, (a)/ the firefighters found an ablaze house (b)/ in the middle of the street (c)/ with flames everywhere. (d)
questions.solutionHinglish:
Ans (b) replace 'an ablaze house' with 'a house which was ablaze'
Explanation:- 'ablaze, ill, well, afraid, alive etc.' humesha predicatively (linking verb ke baad) use hote hai, noun se pehle nahi.

questions.question: The needy (a)/ is often overlooked (b)/ by society, even though they contribute in countless ways to the community. (c)/ no error (d)
questions.solutionHinglish:
Ans (b) replace 'is' with 'are'
Explanation:- 'the needy' ka matlab hai 'saare jaruratmand log' (common plural noun), isliye iske sath 'are' plural verb aayegi.

questions.question: Find the part of the given sentence that has an error in it.
options: (a) This article says that Tamarind tastes
(b) more sourly than any other fruit
(c) in the whole world, but it is commonly
(d) used in making various Indian dishes
questions.solutionHinglish:
Ans (b) replace 'more sourly' with 'sourer'
Explanation:- 'taste' yahan linking verb hai jiske baad adjective aata hai. Comparison ke liye comparative degree adjective 'sourer' sahi hoga.

questions.question: Driving on the right(a)/ is counterintuitively to the man(b)/ who has spent most(c)/ of the time driving in India(d).
questions.solutionHinglish:
Ans (b) replace 'counterintuitively' with 'counterintuitive'
Explanation:- 'is' linking verb hai jiske baad subject complement ke roop mein adjective ('counterintuitive') aata hai.

questions.question: She executed the shot known(a)/ throughout the cricket world(b) /for its complexity as good as(c)/ Dhoni did in 2009(d).
questions.solutionHinglish:
Ans (c) replace 'good' with 'well'
Explanation:- Do action verbs ('executed' aur 'did') ka comparison karna hai, isliye adverb 'as well as' sahi hoga.

questions.question: Of the three runners who(a)/ participated in one of the biggest (b)/ marathons, he was fast(c) /No error(d).
questions.solutionHinglish:
Ans (c) replace 'fast' with 'the fastest'
Explanation:- Teen logon mein se sabse best/fast kehne ke liye superlative degree 'the fastest' ka use hoga.

questions.question: Ancient India had(a) /many people responsible(b)/ who carried out their responsibilities(c)/ through thick and thin(d).
questions.solutionHinglish:
Ans (b) replace 'people responsible' with 'responsible people'
Explanation:- Noun se pehle 'responsible' positive meaning ('jimmedar log') deta hai. Sentence mein positive meaning dena hai, isliye 'responsible people' sahi hoga.

questions.question: In a world where promises(a)/ are often made but not(b) /fulfilled, we should try to(c)/ be a true man to his word (d).
questions.solutionHinglish:
Ans (d) replace 'true man' with 'man true'
Explanation:- 'to his word' phrase 'true' adjective ke liye aaya hai, isliye adjective noun ke baad ('a man true to his word') aayega.

questions.question: This newly launched book contains questions(a)/ relevant to the exam but(b) /the three last have never(c)/ been seen before(d).
questions.solutionHinglish:
Ans (c) replace 'three last' with 'last three'
Explanation:- Ordinal ('last') aur cardinal ('three') jab sath mein lage ho toh ordinal cardinal se pehle aata hai, isliye 'the last three' sahi hoga.

questions.question: The new employee whom you can see (a) /standing with our boss (b)/ is a fat big liar(c)/No error(d).
questions.solutionHinglish:
Ans (c) replace 'fat big liar' with 'big fat liar'
Explanation:- Qualitative adjective ke sequence mein 'big' (size) 'fat' (shape) se pehle aayega, isliye 'big fat liar' sahi hoga.

questions.question: The new guidelines regarding the(a)/ delegation of financial power(b)/ to the head of offices have (c)/not yet been implanted despite repeating notices(d).
questions.solutionHinglish:
Ans (d) replace 'repeating notices' with 'repeated notices'
Explanation:- Sentence mein 'baar baar bheje gaye notices' ka meaning dena hai, isliye past participle 'repeated notices' sahi hoga.

questions.question: Do you know that unlike the Lizard, the(a)/ rat's tail can't grow back(b)/ after it has been cut intentionally or unintentionally (c)/No error (d)
questions.solutionHinglish:
Ans (a) use 'apostrophe(s)' with 'lizard' (Lizard's)
Explanation:- Sentence mein 'lizard ki tail' ka comparison 'rat ki tail' se karna hai, isliye yahan 'lizard's' sahi hoga.

questions.question: As per this new notice, every of the employees(a)/ who came late at the boss (b)/ last meeting will(c)/ be fined/(d).
questions.solutionHinglish:
Ans (a) replace 'every' with 'each'
Explanation:- 'every' sirf adjective ban sakta hai jabki 'each' pronoun aur adjective dono ban sakta hai. 'of' se pehle pronoun 'each' subject banega.

questions.question: I hope you know that since he is very fastidious(a)/ about almost everything, a little people(b)/ are happy with him (c)/No error (d)
questions.solutionHinglish:
Ans (b) replace 'a little' with 'few'
Explanation:- 'people' countable noun hai aur negative meaning ('naa ke barabar log') ke liye 'few' adjective sahi hoga.

questions.question: Since he has joined the company(a)/ recently, he doesn't (b)/have some experience(c)/ regarding this task(d).
questions.solutionHinglish:
Ans (c) replace 'some' with 'any'
Explanation:- Negative aur interrogative sentences mein 'any' ko prefer karte hai, isliye 'any experience' sahi hoga.

questions.question: The NGO whose services (a)/were benefitting the(b)/ society was suddenly(c)/ closed down by the autocratic government(d).
questions.solutionHinglish:
Ans (a) replace 'whose services' with 'the services of which'
Explanation:- 'whose' human beings pe possession banane ke liye lagaya jata hai, non-living/organization ('NGO') ke sath 'the services of which' likhenge.

questions.question: It is the most (a)/eternal fact that we reap what (b)/ we sow whether we accept it or not (c)/No error(d).
questions.solutionHinglish:
Ans (a) remove 'most' before 'eternal'
Explanation:- 'eternal' non-gradable/absolute adjective hai, isliye 'eternal' se pehle 'most' nahi aayega.

questions.question: I can guarantee that Madhuri is wittier and wiser (a)/than any(b)/ other boy in her class (c)/. No error (d)
questions.solutionHinglish:
Ans (c) remove 'other'
Explanation:- Madhuri (ladki) ladko ke group ka part nahi hai, isliye exclude karne ke liye 'other' lagane ki jarurat nahi hai ('than any boy in her class').

questions.question: Confidence in one's (a)/abilities is crucial for(b)/a successful business, as(c)/ it helps in building a strength foundation(d).
questions.solutionHinglish:
Ans (d) replace 'strength' with 'strong'
Explanation:- 'foundation' noun ko qualify karne ke liye adjective ('strong') ki jarurat hoti hai, isliye 'strong foundation' sahi hoga.

questions.question: The smartphones are among(a)/ the more useful(b)/technologies that (c)/ have been invented till now.(d)
questions.solutionHinglish:
Ans (b) replace 'more' with 'most'
Explanation:- Ek cheez ka comparison abhi tak ki sabhi technologies se karna hai, isliye superlative degree 'the most useful' sabse sahi hoga.

questions.question: I have made it a point to call my teachers on September 5 as a token of mine gratitude.
options: (d) it a point to call my teachers
questions.solutionHinglish:
Ans (c) replace 'mine gratitude' with 'my gratitude'
Explanation:- 'gratitude' noun ko qualify karne ke liye possessive adjective 'my' aayega, naa ki possessive pronoun 'mine'.

questions.question: I think that he sang beautifully but I don't know why the judges were unimpress at the end.
options: (c) I think that he sang beautifully
questions.solutionHinglish:
Ans (b) replace 'unimpress' with 'unimpressed'
Explanation:- 'were' linking verb ke baad subject complement ke roop mein adjective ('unimpressed') aata hai.

questions.question: I have three sisters: Meera is the elder and Charu is the youngest.
questions.solutionHinglish:
Ans (d) replace 'elder' with 'eldest'
Explanation:- Teeno sisters mein se Meera ko sabse bada batane ke liye superlative degree 'the eldest' ka use karenge.

questions.question: We used to keep large plates of fruit on a table nearer this window in the dining room.
questions.solutionHinglish:
Ans (b) replace 'nearer' with 'near'
Explanation:- Sentence mein koi comparison nahi karna balki 'window ke pass' kehne ke liye 'near' ka use karenge.

questions.question: Some people believe that no matter how hardly you may try, success comes to you at its own time.
options: (b) Some people believe that no matter
(c) to you at its own time
questions.solutionHinglish:
Ans (d) replace 'hardly' with 'hard'
Explanation:- 'hardly' ka matlab 'naa ke barabar' hota hai. 'Koshish/mehnat' waale meaning ke liye yahan 'how hard you may try' sahi hoga.

questions.question: Venus, the hottest planet in the solar system, has not enjoyed as much as recent attention as Mars.
options: (b) as much as recent attention as Mars.
(c) Venus, the hottest planet in the solar
questions.solutionHinglish:
Ans (b) remove 'as' in between 'much' and 'recent attention'
Explanation:- Structure 'as + adjective + noun + as' hota hai, isliye 'as much recent attention as Mars' sahi hoga.

questions.question: You should not be that (a)/cynical. Mr. Surya has no interior motive (b)/ in offering you support. (c)/ No error (d)
questions.solutionHinglish:
Ans (b) replace 'interior' with 'ulterior'
Explanation:- 'ulterior motive' ka matlab hota hai 'kisi baat ke peeche chupa hua irada', isliye 'ulterior motive' sahi hoga.

questions.question: I could not believe that (a)/ Ajay got into a fight with those (b)/ thugs. I always thought (c)/that he is smarter than brave. (d)
questions.solutionHinglish:
Ans (d) replace 'smarter' with 'more smart'
Explanation:- Ek hee person ki do qualities ka aapas mein comparison karna ho toh 'er' wala structure nahi balki 'more smart than brave' use hota hai.

questions.question: You can emphasize either of these four syllables in the poem written by Shakespeare who is also known as the Kalidasa of England.
questions.solutionHinglish:
Ans (a) correct answer is 'emphasize any of these'
Explanation:- Sentence mein 'four syllables' (more than two) ki baat ho rahi hai, isliye 'either' ki jagah 'any' ka use hota hai.

questions.question: The Japanese people are known for their commitment toward the nation and praised for their efficiency
questions.solutionHinglish:
Ans (b) Correct answer is 'The Japanese'
Explanation:- 'The Japanese' ka matlab hee hota hai 'Japan ke log', isliye concise expression 'The Japanese' option B sahi hoga.

questions.question: The student responded to the question so logically that the audience praised his analytic approach repeatedly despite the time constraints.
questions.solutionHinglish:
Ans (c) Correct answer is 'analytical approach repeatedly'
Explanation:- 'approach' noun ko qualify karne ke liye standard adjective 'analytical' aur verb ke liye adverb 'repeatedly' option C sahi hoga.

questions.question: This shirt which is newly launched in the market cost me five thousand rupee
questions.solutionHinglish:
Ans (d) Correct answer is 'cost me five thousand rupees'
Explanation:- Main noun 'rupees' plural aayega aur usse pehle 'five thousand' adjective singular rahega, isliye option D sahi hoga.

questions.question: Of the two plans submitted by the architect, this is the one much likely to be accepted.
questions.solutionHinglish:
Ans (b) Correct answer is 'more likely'
Explanation:- 2 plans mein comparison karna hai, isliye comparative degree 'more likely' wala option B sahi hoga.

questions.question: Prashant is good from more other players of our school who participated in the All India Cricket Championship League.
questions.solutionHinglish:
Ans (c) Correct answer is 'better than most other'
Explanation:- Prashant ka comparison baaki players se karna hai, isliye comparative degree 'better than most other' wala option C sahi hoga.

questions.question: Please tell me if you also think that no bird is more taller than a ostrich.
options: (a) no bird is much taller than an ostrich
(b) no other bird is as tall as an ostrich
(c) no bird is taller than ostrich
questions.solutionHinglish:
Ans (b) Correct answer is 'no other bird is as tall as an ostrich'
Explanation:- Ostrich ko birds waale group se 'other' lagake exclude kiya gaya hai aur simile structure 'as tall as an ostrich' grammatically bilkul sahi hai.

questions.question: A renowned chemist claimed that taking up to 50 times the commendable dose of vitamin-c could treat anything from influenza to cancer.
questions.solutionHinglish:
Ans (b) Correct answer is 'recommended'
Explanation:- 'recommended dose' ka matlab hoga 'aisa dose jiski salaah di gayi ho'. Isliye option B sahi hoga.

questions.question: When I was in Europe last year, I used to roam around in London on alternate days.
questions.solutionHinglish:
Ans (d) Correct answer is 'no improvement'
Explanation:- 'alternate days' ka matlab 'ek din chhodke ek din'. Toh meaning ke according 'alternate days' bilkul sahi hai.

questions.question: The prime minister's speech laid out how important it is to encourage female participate in the economy yet the percentage of female lawmakers in the lower house of the parliament has fallen to 8%
questions.solutionHinglish:
Ans (b) Correct answer is 'female participation'
Explanation:- 'to encourage' infinitive ka object noun ('female participation') banega, isliye option B sahi hoga.

questions.question: He claimed that he was merely an uninterested participant in the negotiation held by senior officers.
questions.solutionHinglish:
Ans (b) Correct answer is 'a disinterested'
Explanation:- 'disinterested' ka matlab 'unbiased/impartial (pakshpaat nahi karne wala)', toh meaning ke according 'a disinterested' option B sahi hoga.

questions.question: He has told me that of Rajni and Usha, the later is the most responsible.
questions.solutionHinglish:
Ans (b) Correct answer is 'The latter is more'
Explanation:- Do logon (Rajni aur Usha) mein se baad waale ke liye 'latter' aur comparison ke liye comparative degree 'more' option B sahi hoga.

questions.question: 50 Chinese couples were married at a ceremony in Colombo to mark the anniversary of (diplomat relations between the two countries).
options: (a) Diplomatic relations among the two countries
(b) Diplomatic relations between the two countries
questions.solutionHinglish:
Ans (b) Correct answer is 'Diplomatic relations between the two countries'
Explanation:- 'relations' noun se pehle 'Diplomatic' adjective aayega aur do countries ke liye 'between the two countries' option B sahi hoga.

questions.question: The people living in the coastal areas experience a interested phenomenon.
questions.solutionHinglish:
Ans (d) Correct answer is 'an interesting phenomenon'
Explanation:- Present participle adjective 'interesting' aur vowel sound ke liye 'an' article yaani 'an interesting phenomenon' option D sahi hoga.

questions.question: Among all the novels I have read in the past year, this one is far the most engaging.
questions.solutionHinglish:
Ans (a) Correct answer is 'by far the most engaging'
Explanation:- Superlative degree ki intensity badhaani ho toh 'by far the most engaging' wala option A sahi hoga.

questions.question: The branches of the old mango tree were ______ heavy ripe, golden mangoes.
questions.solutionHinglish:
Ans (b) Correct answer is 'laden with'
Explanation:- Trees pe lage fruits ke liye 'loaded' nahi 'laden with' ka use hota hai. Isliye option B sahi hoga.

questions.question: Despite its simple appearance, this grammar book is arguably ______ resource I've encountered.
questions.solutionHinglish:
Ans (c) Correct answer is 'the most effective'
Explanation:- Aaj tak ki sabhi books se comparison ke liye superlative degree 'the most effective' option C sahi hoga.

questions.question: All our (a)/ furnitures were (b)/ spoiled in the recent (c)/ rains and floods. (d)
questions.solutionHinglish:
Ans (b) use 'furniture was' instead of 'furnitures were'
Explanation:- kyunki 'furniture' ek uncountable noun hai iska plural form nahi hota hai.
Note:- Jab kuch dino tak lagatar barish aur baadh aa rhi ho to uske liye Rains and Floods ka use kar sakte hai.

questions.question: Mother-in-laws from different (a)/ daily soaps have been (b)/ nominated for this category. (c)/ no error (d)
questions.solutionHinglish:
Ans (a) Use 'mothers-in-law' in place of 'mother-in-laws'.
Explanation:- Compound noun ka plural karne ke liye noun ki tarah act karne wale word ka plural karte hain.
Note:- Iss sentence me soaps ka matlb sabun nhi hai. 'daily soaps' matlb roj aane wale TV serials.

questions.question: My neighbour's grandson (a)/ is only (b)/ five month old.(c)/ no error (d)
questions.solutionHinglish:
Ans (c) use 'months' instead of 'month'
Explanation:- kyunki 'five' ek numeral adjective hai iske baad plural noun ka use hoga.

questions.question: The efficiency of an (a)/ employee also depends on the (b)/ surrounding in which he or she works.(c)/ no error (d)
questions.solutionHinglish:
Ans (c) Use 'surroundings' in place of 'surrounding'.
Explanation:- yahan 'on' preposition ka object banane ke liye ek noun ki need hai. surrounding = adjective, surroundings = noun.

questions.question: There have been (a)/ three breaks-in (b)/ in our society (c)/ this month.(d)
questions.solutionHinglish:
Ans (b) use 'break-ins' instead of 'breaks-in'
Explanation:- kyunki 'break-in' ka plural 'break-ins' hota hai. Break-in = the crime of entering a building by damaging a door or window, usually in order to steal.

questions.question: I want to know (a)/ where the headquarter of (b)/ Delhi police is situated.(c)/ no error (d)
questions.solutionHinglish:
Ans (b) Use 'headquarters' in place of 'headquarter'
Explanation:- 'headquarters' un nouns me se hai jinki singular and plural me spelling same hi rehti hai.

questions.question: We bought (a)/ two dozens (b)/ mangoes from (c)/ the market.(d)
questions.solutionHinglish:
Ans (b) use 'two dozen' instead of 'two dozens'
Explanation:- kyunki yahan 'two dozen' ko 'mangoes' noun ke liye adjective ki tarah use kiya jaa raha hai isliye iska plural nahi hoga.

questions.question: Some seats are (a)/ reserved for disabled (b)/ in each compartment. (c)/ no error (d)
questions.solutionHinglish:
Ans (b) Use 'the disabled' or 'disabled people' in place of 'disabled'.
Explanation:- Yahan 'for' preposition ka object banane ke liye noun ki zarurat hai. The disabled = all the disabled people.

questions.question: I do not (a)/ like to read (b)/ these kind (c)/ of novels.(d)
questions.solutionHinglish:
Ans (c) use 'this kind' or 'these kinds' instead of 'these kind'
Explanation:- plural noun ke sath 'these' and singular noun ke sath 'this' ka use hoga.

questions.question: The balance in his saving (a)/ account is not enough for him to (b)/ avail himself of these facilities.(c)/ no error (d)
questions.solutionHinglish:
Ans (a) Use 'savings' in place of 'saving'.
Explanation:- 'Savings' and 'Earnings' jab noun/modifier ka kaam karti hai tab humesha plural ('savings account') me hi likhe jaate hain.

questions.question: Shall (a)/ we go (b)/ for walking (c)/ in the park?(d)
questions.solutionHinglish:
Ans (c) use 'a walk' instead of 'walking'
Explanation:- kyunki 'go for a walk/ride/drive/run/swim' ek fixed phrase hota hai. Jahan noun possible hota hai wahan jabardasti gerund nahi lagate hain.

questions.question: The President of India (a)/ constitutional power is limitless (b)/ but it is the P.M. who is, (c)/ indeed, powerful.(d)
questions.solutionHinglish:
Ans (a) Use 'India's' in place of 'India'.
Explanation:- Yahan kehna hai ki India ke president ki constitutional power limitless hai isliye 'President of India's' (apostrophe 's') lagega.

questions.question: The Principal requested (a)/ the teacher's (b)/ to monitor (c)/ and take care of the small children.(d)
questions.solutionHinglish:
Ans (b) use 'teachers' instead of 'teacher's'
Explanation:- kyunki 'teacher' ka plural 'teachers' hota hai 'teacher's' nahi. Yahan koi possession nahi banana hai.

questions.question: There was (a)/ no money in the bank (b)/ in Dhananjay's (c)/ and Mritunjay's joint account.(d)
questions.solutionHinglish:
Ans (c) Use 'Dhananjay' in place of 'Dhananjay's'
Explanation:- Jab 2 nouns ka ek common cheez (joint account) par possession hota hai toh apostrophe ('s) sirf baad wale noun par lagate hain.

questions.question: The boy had run away (a)/ because he couldn't stand (b)/ his father beat him (c)/ for one more day.(d)
questions.solutionHinglish:
Ans (c) Use 'his father's beating' instead of 'his father beat'
Explanation:- 'Could not stand' verb ka object 'beating' gerund banega aur usse pehle likhe 'father' noun ko possessive case me karke 'father's' karna padega.

questions.question: The offsprings of this (a)/ species leave their parents (b)/ as soon as they mature. (c)/ no error (d)
questions.solutionHinglish:
Ans (a) Use 'offspring' in place of 'offsprings'.
Explanation:- Kyunki 'offspring' ese nouns me se ek hai jinka singular and plural form same rehta hai.

questions.question: Doctors say that (a)/ home isolation is (b)/ far more effective (c)/ than hospitalize in cases of mild infection.(d)
questions.solutionHinglish:
Ans (d) use 'hospitalization' instead of 'hospitalize'
Explanation:- kyunki yahan 'isolation' noun se comparison karna hai aur noun ka comparison noun ('hospitalization') se hi hoga.

questions.question: He did not know even (a)/ the name of the scientist (b)/ who discovered (c)/ the laws of the earth gravitational force.(d)
questions.solutionHinglish:
Ans (d) Use 'earth's' in place of 'earth'.
Explanation:- Celestial bodies ke sath apostrophe ('s) laga sakte hain ('the earth's gravitational force').

questions.question: Your advices were timely (a)/ and guided me (b)/ to take the right decisions.(c)/ no error (d)
questions.solutionHinglish:
Ans (a) use 'pieces of advice / bits of advice' instead of 'advices'
Explanation:- kyunki 'advice' ek uncountable noun hai iska plural form nahi hota hai.

questions.question: His maid servant (a)/ behaviour is undoubtedly (b)/ indecent but I don't (c)/ understand how he tolerates it.(d)
questions.solutionHinglish:
Ans (a) Use 'servant's behaviour' in place of 'servant behaviour'.
Explanation:- Yahan 'servant ka behaviour' yeh meaning dena hai isliye apostrophe ('s) lagana padega.

questions.question: She speaks (a)/ very highly (b)/ of both her (c)/ daughter-in-laws.(d)
questions.solutionHinglish:
Ans (d) use 'daughters-in-law' instead of 'daughter-in-laws'
Explanation:- kyunki 'daughter-in-law' ka plural 'daughters-in-law' hota hai.

questions.question: It was India's (a)/ past glory (b)/ that attracted a number of invaders in the remote past. (c)/no error (d)
questions.solutionHinglish:
Ans (d) No error.
Explanation:- Country and city ke name ke sath apostrophe ('s) laga sakte hain. Eg. India's past glory.

questions.question: His loyalty (a)/ and honesty (b)/ are above (c)/ suspect.(d)
questions.solutionHinglish:
Ans (d) use 'suspicion' instead of 'suspect'
Explanation:- above suspicion = sandeh ke pare. Suspect = person believed to be guilty; Suspicion = feeling/belief of doubt.

questions.question: Many of us don't (a)/ know the exact reason (b)/ behind the earthquake. (c)/ no error (d)
questions.solutionHinglish:
Ans (b) Use 'cause' in place of 'reason'.
Explanation:- Apne aap hone wale natural events ki wajah ke liye 'cause' word ka use karte hai.

questions.question: His mean (a)/ are very limited (b)/ yet he does not curtail (c)/ his expenditure and spends lavishly.(d)
questions.solutionHinglish:
Ans (a) Use 'means' in place of 'mean'.
Explanation:- 'Income/resources' wale meaning me 'means' word ka hi use hota hai aur iske sath verb plural aati hai.

questions.question: The information (a)/ you are (b)/ asking for (c)/ is quite irrelevance. (d)
questions.solutionHinglish:
Ans (d) use 'irrelevant' instead of 'irrelevance'
Explanation:- kyunki 'irrelevance' ek noun hai jabki 'irrelevant' ek adjective hai aur yahan 'is quite' ke baad adjective ki zarurat hai.

questions.question: Annu saw (a)/ her shade (b)/ in the river.(c)/ no error (d)
questions.solutionHinglish:
Ans (b) Use 'shadow' in place of 'shade'.
Explanation:- Shadow = Parchhai (reflection/dark shape); Shade = Dhoop se chhaya.

questions.question: The man played (a)/ the flute and led (b)/ all the mouse (c)/ out of the town.(d)
questions.solutionHinglish:
Ans (c) use 'mice' instead of 'mouse'
Explanation:- kyunki 'mouse' ka plural 'mice' hota hai.

questions.question: The French (a)/ have strange (b)/ habits.(c)/ no error (d)
questions.solutionHinglish:
Ans (c) Use 'customs' in place of 'habits'.
Explanation:- Ek single person ki aadat ke liye 'habit' word ka use hota hai aur society/community me follow kiye jaane wale rivaaz ke liye 'customs' word ka use hota hai.

questions.question: He loses (a)/ his tempers on (b)/ the slightest (c)/ provocation.(d)
questions.solutionHinglish:
Ans (b) use 'temper' instead of 'tempers'
Explanation:- kyunki 'temper' ek uncountable noun hai iska plural form nahi hota hai ('lose his temper').

questions.question: The Commonwealth Games had (a)/ a grand opening (b)/ ceremony with spectacular (c)/ cultural performings.(d)
questions.solutionHinglish:
Ans (d) use 'performances' instead of 'performings'
Explanation:- kyunki 'perform' verb ki noun form 'performance' (plural 'performances') hoti hai.

questions.question: The long-distance train (a)/ which met with an accident (b)/ was carrying some army personal.(c)/ no error (d)
questions.solutionHinglish:
Ans (c) Use 'personnel' in place of 'personal'
Explanation:- Personal = Niji (adjective); Personnel = Staff/employees (noun).

questions.question: The publics are (a)/not satisfied (b)/ with the (c)/ new act.(d)
questions.solutionHinglish:
Ans (a) use 'the public is' instead of 'the publics are'
Explanation:- kyunki 'public' noun ka plural 'publics' nahi hota.

questions.question: Your son's-in-law's (a)/ friend is seriously ill (b)/ and he wants you (c)/ to see him as soon as possible.(d)
questions.solutionHinglish:
Ans (a) Use 'son-in-law's friend' in place of 'son's-in-law's friend'.
Explanation:- Compound noun me possession dikhane ke liye sirf aakhiri word ('law's') par apostrophe lagta hai.

questions.question: They had to wait (a)/ for the luggages (b)/ to be put into the cab (c)/ before they themselves got into it.(d)
questions.solutionHinglish:
Ans (b) use 'luggage' instead of 'luggages'
Explanation:- kyunki 'luggage' ek uncountable noun hai iska plural form nahi hota hai.

questions.question: The modern man is busy (a)/ acquiring more and more wealth (b)/ and designing ways to invest it (c)/ in more sense pleasures.(d)
questions.solutionHinglish:
Ans (d) use 'sensuous' instead of 'sense'
Explanation:- kyunki 'pleasures' ek noun hai iske pehle adjective ('sensuous') ka use hoga.

questions.question: The survey gives (a)/ us much knowledge of the (b)/ public's opinion (c)/ on the matter of terrorism.(d)
questions.solutionHinglish:
Ans (c) Use 'public' in place of 'public's'.
Explanation:- kyunki 'public opinion' ek compound noun ya fix expression hai.

questions.question: Among the reasons cited by the employee (a)/ for quitting the job were the pressure of work, the outstation duties (b)/ and desiring to pursue her hobbies.(c)/ no error (d)
questions.solutionHinglish:
Ans (c) use 'the desire' instead of 'desiring'
Explanation:- Parallelism maintain karne ke liye 'the pressure of work', 'the outstation duties' ke sath 'the desire to pursue her hobbies' noun ka use hoga.

questions.question: 'Language consists of several stratums', (a)/ said a linguist (b)/ in his lecture on Language (c)/ and Linguistics.(d)
questions.solutionHinglish:
Ans (a) Use 'strata' in place of 'stratums'.
Explanation:- 'stratum' ka plural 'strata' hota hai.

questions.question: The chart papers (a)/ were distributed (b)/ among all (c)/ the childrens (d)
questions.solutionHinglish:
Ans (d) use 'children' instead of 'childrens'
Explanation:- kyunki 'children' khud hi plural noun hai isme 's' nahi lagta.

questions.question: Your tone of speaking (a)/ as well as your friends (b)/ is extremely sarcastic (c)/ yet we never take it seriously.(d)
questions.solutionHinglish:
Ans (b) Use 'friend's' in place of 'friends'.
Explanation:- kyunki sentence ke meaning ke according 'friend' ka tone par possession banana hai ('your friend's').

questions.question: My visiting to (a)/ my family are (b)/ few and far between.(c)/ no error (d)
questions.solutionHinglish:
Ans (a) use 'My visits to' instead of 'My visiting to'
Explanation:- 'are' verb se pta chal rha hai ki yahan plural noun 'visits' ka use kiya jayega.

questions.question: He did not approve (a)/ of his son raising (b)/stupid questions and thereby (c)/ vexing the teacher. (d)
questions.solutionHinglish:
Ans (b) Use 'son's' in place of 'son'
Explanation:- Yahan 'approve of' phrasal verb ka object 'raising' gerund banega. Isliye gerund se pehle 'son' noun ko possessive case ('son's') me karna padega.

questions.question: These (a)/ stray cattles (b)/ are roaming around (c)/ the town.(d)
questions.solutionHinglish:
Ans (b) use 'cattle' instead of 'cattles'
Explanation:- kyunki 'cattle' khud hi ek plural noun hai.

questions.question: You shall get (a)/ all the informations (b)/ if you read this book carefully. (c)/ no error (d)
questions.solutionHinglish:
Ans (b) Use 'information' in place of 'informations'.
Explanation:- kyunki 'information' uncountable noun hai iska plural nahi hoga.

questions.question: We have taken on (a)/ the responsibility of (b)/ arranging the required training (c)/ and supervise of the new staff. (d)
questions.solutionHinglish:
Ans (d) Use 'supervising the new staff' in place of 'supervise of the new staff'
Explanation:- Yahan 'arranging' and 'supervising' gerunds ko 'and' se joda gya hai isliye parallelism ke according gerund use hoga.

questions.question: 'I have never seen (a)/ such a lovely spectacles (b)/ in my life', said (c)/ the passer-by.(d)
questions.solutionHinglish:
Ans (b) Use 'spectacle' in place of 'spectacles'.
Explanation:- Spectacles = chasma; Spectacle = drishya/scene. Sentence ke meaning ke according yahan 'spectacle' aayega.

questions.question: With the literacy rates in this (a)/ region as low as 10% (b)/ we need to encourage the (c)/ local people to build schools.(d)
questions.solutionHinglish:
Ans (a) Use 'rate' in place of 'rates'.
Explanation:- Kisi ek region ki literacy rate obviously ek hi hogi toh 'rate' noun ko singular me likha jayega.

questions.question: Hectic schedules can (a)/ take a toll on anybody and (b)/ the solutions to this is (c)/ a quick holiday to some exotic location.(d)
questions.solutionHinglish:
Ans (c) Use 'solution' in place of 'solutions'.
Explanation:- Yahan 'is' singular verb ka use hua hai aur aage 'a quick holiday' ek hi solution likha hai toh 'the solution' singular aayega.

questions.question: Owing to his heavy engagement, (a)/ he could not write even the two-third (b)/ of the book of which (c)/ the publication was extended before January.(d)
questions.solutionHinglish:
Ans (b) Use 'two-thirds' in place of 'two-third'.
Explanation:- Jab fractions me numerator 1 se bada hota hai toh denominator me 's' aata hai (two-thirds, three-fourths).

questions.question: Since you are unable (a)/ to repay the loan you have no alternate (b)/ but to seek (c)/ an extension.(d)
questions.solutionHinglish:
Ans (b) Use 'alternative' instead of 'alternate'.
Explanation:- Alternative = other option (noun); Alternate = ek chhod ke ek (adjective).

questions.question: Some required measures (a)/ have to be taken to increase (b)/ the proceed of the annual sale. (c)/ no error (d)
questions.solutionHinglish:
Ans (c) Use 'proceeds' in place of 'proceed'.
Explanation:- proceed (verb) = aage badhna; proceeds (noun) = money received from a sale/event.

questions.question: My uncle's secretary's wife (a)/ is (b)/ very charming.(c) no error (d)
questions.solutionHinglish:
Ans (a) Use 'The wife of my uncle's secretary' in place of 'My uncle's secretary's wife'.
Explanation:- Sentence mein do apostrophe 's' ka lagatar use sath mein nahi karte, isliye isse 'of' structure se banayenge.

questions.question: It will take at least (a)/ one and a half year (b)/ to complete this project. (c)/ no error (d)
questions.solutionHinglish:
Ans (b) Use 'years' in place of 'year'.
Explanation:- 'one and a half' (1.5) ek se jyada hai, isliye iske sath noun plural ('years') aayegi.

questions.question: The Karkardooma court has issued (a)/ five summons against him (b)/ so far, but he (c)/ has attended to none of them.(d)
questions.solutionHinglish:
Ans (b) Use 'summonses' in place of 'summons'.
Explanation:- 'summons' singular countable noun hai aur 'five' ke sath iska plural 'summonses' hoga.

questions.question: I do not (a)/ know (b)/ my date of birth. (c)/ no error (d)
questions.solutionHinglish:
Ans (c) Use 'the date of my birth' in place of 'my date of birth'.
Explanation:- Formal grammar ke according 'the date of my birth' sahi usage hai.

questions.question: The extra benefits in addition to its (a)/ flexibility of operation (b)/ and superior finish makes (c)/ it the most desirable machine of its kind.(d)
questions.solutionHinglish:
Ans (c) Use 'make' in place of 'makes'
Explanation:- Iss verb ka main subject 'The extra benefits' hai jo ki plural hai, isliye plural verb 'make' aayegi.

questions.question: Cannot you see (a)/ that the cattle (b)/ is grazing in the field? (c)/ So, you cannot play there.(d)
questions.solutionHinglish:
Ans (c) Use 'are' in place of 'is'
Explanation:- 'cattle' plural noun hai uske liye plural verb 'are' aayegi.

questions.question: The gentry of Mumbai does not (a)/ like Salman Khan at (b)/ all, even though he has (c)/a number of good movies to his credit.(d)
questions.solutionHinglish:
Ans (a) Use 'do' in place of 'does'.
Explanation:- 'gentry' (people of high social class) plural noun hai uske liye verb plural ('do not') aayegi.

questions.question: Would you please (a)/ tell me how many (b)/ soaps do you (c)/ use in a month.(d)
questions.solutionHinglish:
Ans (c) Use 'bars/cakes of soap you' in place of 'soaps do you'
Explanation:- 'Soap' uncountable noun hai, ek se zyada kehne ke liye 'cakes/bars of soap' likhna padega.

questions.question: The Indian independence movement sought to establish the conceptions of freedom and social welfare as the goals of an independent Indian state, resulting in Fundamental Rights and Directive Principles.
questions.solutionHinglish:
Ans (b)
Explanation:- Yhan meaning ke according 'concepts of liberty' (ideas of freedom) ka use hoga.

questions.question: National development is defined as an improvement in people's daily arrangements, the provision of fundamental necessities to citizens such as food, education, social services, medical help, and so on, as well as increase in per capita income.
questions.solutionHinglish:
Ans (d)
Explanation:- Yhan meaning ke according 'living conditions' option D ka use hoga.

questions.question: In today's digital age, information is widely available to everyone by many means of media such as television, newspapers, films, and social media.
questions.solutionHinglish:
Ans (c)
Explanation:- Koi cheez jab kisi medium se transfer hoti hai uske liye 'via various forms' option C ka use hoga.

questions.question: Disability was viewed as God's retribution for wickedness in the past.
questions.solutionHinglish:
Ans (b)
Explanation:- 'retribution for wickedness' ka meaning 'punishment for wrongdoing' (option B) hai.

questions.question: I've got a lot of homeworks this weekend.
questions.solutionHinglish:
Ans (a)
Explanation:- 'Homework' uncountable noun hai iska plural nhi banta. Option A 'a lot of homework' sahi hai.

questions.question:
Substitute the underlined words with the option that is closest in meaning to it.
Give us some room for improvement.
options: (b) room in a house for improvement
questions.solutionHinglish:
Ans (a)
Explanation:- 'room for improvement' ka meaning hai scope/chance/an opportunity for improvement (option A).

questions.question: After a prolonged discussion, Gayatri got a permission from her parents to study law.
questions.solutionHinglish:
Ans (c)
Explanation:- 'Permission' uncountable noun ki tarah use hua hai isliye bina article ke 'got permission' (option C) use hoga.

questions.question: Rumour mongering is one of the bad habit.
questions.solutionHinglish:
Ans (d)
Explanation:- 'One of + the + plural noun' structure use hota hai, isliye 'one of the bad habits' (option D) use hoga.

questions.question: Major hubs of the information technology industry is the Silicon Valley of Central California.
questions.solutionHinglish:
Ans (b)
Explanation:- Sentence me singular verb 'is' use ki gyi hai, isliye singular subject 'A major hub of' (option B) ka use hoga.

questions.question: My assistant will see you in the meets next week.
questions.solutionHinglish:
Ans (d)
Explanation:- Preposition ke baad noun 'the meeting' lagega aur meeting ke sath 'at' preposition ayegi, isliye 'at the meeting' (option D) sahi hai.

questions.question: Megha's habit of procrastination puts her colleagues on lot of trouble.
questions.solutionHinglish:
Ans (a)
Explanation:- 'Put someone to a lot of trouble' सही phrase hota hai, isliye option A sahi hai.

questions.question: These days I like to eat nuts and seeds along with fruits as I'm conscious of my healthfulness.
questions.solutionHinglish:
Ans (b)
Explanation:- Yhan 'my' ke baad noun 'health' (option B) sahi hai.

questions.question: Bats huddle together to get warm of each other's body.
questions.solutionHinglish:
Ans (d)
Explanation:- Yhan 'to get' infinitive ka object bnane ke liye noun 'warmth' aur source ke liye 'from' yaani 'warmth from' (option D) sahi hai.

questions.question: India has identified a nose-based vaccine against Covid-19 that could be a 'game-changer'.
questions.solutionHinglish:
Ans (b)
Explanation:- Nose ke through li jane wali vaccine ko 'a nasal vaccine' (option B) kehte hain.

questions.question: These days, wherever district courts are functioning, hearings is limit to urgent matters.
questions.solutionHinglish:
Ans (a)
Explanation:- Subject 'hearings' plural hai aur present tense hai, isliye 'hearings are limited' (option A) sahi hai.

questions.question: A large swarm of dogs was blocking the way.
questions.solutionHinglish:
Ans (a)
Explanation:- Dogs ke group ke liye 'pack of' word ka use hota hai isliye A option sahi hai.

questions.question: In the jungle, I saw a group of lions.
questions.solutionHinglish:
Ans (a)
Explanation:- Lions ke group ke liye 'a pride of lions' word ka use hota hai isliye A option sahi hai.

questions.question: Tons of sheep was grazing in the field.
questions.solutionHinglish:
Ans (a)
Explanation:- Sheep ke group ke liye 'A flock of sheep' word ka use hota hai isliye A option sahi hai.

questions.question: There is a great degrade in values in the modern age.
questions.solutionHinglish:
Ans (a)
Explanation:- Yhan noun 'degradation of values' (moral values me girawat) option A sahi hai.

questions.question: They started playing badminton at a young age of nine years old.
options: (b) the young age of nine years old
(c) a young age of nine years
questions.solutionHinglish:
Ans (a)
Explanation:- 'age' word ka use karne ke baad dobara 'years old' lagana superfluous hai, isliye 'the young age of nine' (option A) sahi hai.

questions.question: The child started crying (a)/ because he couldn't stand (b)/ his mother scold him (c)/ in front of everyone (d).
questions.solutionHinglish:
Ans (c) replace 'his mother scold him' with 'his mother's scolding him'
Explanation:- 'stand' verb ka object gerund 'scolding' banega aur usse pehle 'mother' par apostrophe ('s) aayega.

questions.question: Several commander-in-chiefs (a)/ were invited to attend (b)/ the international defence summit (c)/ in Geneva (d).
questions.solutionHinglish:
Ans (a) replace 'commander-in-chiefs' with 'commanders-in-chief'
Explanation:- Compound noun ka plural karne ke liye main noun 'commander' ke sath 's' lagta hai ('commanders-in-chief').

questions.question: The newly adopted puppy (a)/ has gained weight (b)/ in just three week (c)/ after getting proper food and care (d).
questions.solutionHinglish:
Ans (c) replace 'week' with 'weeks'
Explanation:- 'three' ke baad noun plural ('three weeks') aayega.

questions.question: The mental health of students (a)/ is affected by the (b)/ surrounding in which they study and interact (c)/ with their teachers and peers (d).
questions.solutionHinglish:
Ans (c) replace 'surrounding' with 'surroundings'
Explanation:- 'by the' ke baad noun 'surroundings' ki jarurat hai ('surrounding' adjective hota hai).

questions.question: Due to an increase in (a)/ the number of breaks-in (b)/ the residents decided to install CCTV cameras (c)/ in the entire neighborhood (d).
questions.solutionHinglish:
Ans (b) replace 'breaks-in' with 'break-ins'
Explanation:- 'break-in' ka plural 'break-ins' hota hai.

questions.question: Reporters gathered outside (a)/ the headquarter of (b)/ the Intelligence Bureau (c)/ to cover the press conference (d).
questions.solutionHinglish:
Ans (b) replace 'headquarter' with 'headquarters'
Explanation:- 'headquarters' ki singular aur plural form 'headquarters' hi hoti hai.

questions.question: They supplied (a)/ four dozen (b)/ pencils and (c)/ five dozens notebooks to the school (d).
questions.solutionHinglish:
Ans (d) replace 'five dozens' with 'five dozen'
Explanation:- 'notebooks' noun se pehle 'five dozen' adjective ki tarah kaam kar raha hai aur adjective ka plural nahi hota.

questions.question: The government has announced (a)/ special schemes for disabled (b)/ to improve their standard of living (c)/ in rural areas (d).
questions.solutionHinglish:
Ans (b) put 'the' before 'disabled'
Explanation:- 'the + adjective' ('the disabled') common plural noun banata hai jiska matlab 'disabled log' hota hai.

questions.question: Many readers prefer (a)/ these kind (b)/ of mystery stories which involve unexpected twists (c)/ and deep psychological elements (d).
questions.solutionHinglish:
Ans (b) replace 'these kind' with 'these kinds'
Explanation:- 'these' demonstrative adjective ke baad plural noun 'kinds' aata hai.

questions.question: He has kept the money deposited in his saving (a)/ account aside to (b)/ cover future expenses such as medical bills (c)/ and his children's education (d).
questions.solutionHinglish:
Ans (a) replace 'saving' with 'savings'
Explanation:- Sahi term 'savings account' hoti hai.

questions.question: After finishing all the household chores, (a)/ she suggested that they should (b)/ go for walking (c)/ on the beach (d).
questions.solutionHinglish:
Ans (c) replace 'for walking' with 'for a walk'
Explanation:- Fixed phrase 'go for a walk' hota hai.

questions.question: The Prime Minister of India (a)/ economic vision has been appreciated globally (b)/ as it focuses on sustainable development (c)/ and inclusive growth (d).
questions.solutionHinglish:
Ans (a) replace 'of India' with 'of India's'
Explanation:- 'The Prime Minister of India' ka 'economic vision' par possession dikhane ke liye 'The Prime Minister of India's' aayega.

questions.question: The manager instructed (a)/ all the worker's (b)/ to attend the emergency meeting (c)/ without any delay (d).
questions.solutionHinglish:
Ans (b) replace 'the worker's' with 'the workers'
Explanation:- Yahan plural noun 'workers' chahiye, apostrophe 's' nahi.

questions.question: During the shifting, (a)/ many old furnitures were (b)/ damaged badly because of poor packaging (c)/ and careless handling by the workers (d).
questions.solutionHinglish:
Ans (b) replace 'many old furnitures were' with 'a lot of/much old furniture was'
Explanation:- 'furniture' uncountable noun hai jiska plural nahi hota aur iske sath singular verb 'was' aati hai.

questions.question: In many bird species, (a)/ the offsprings remain in the nest (b)/ for several weeks before they learn to fly (c)/ and become independent (d).
questions.solutionHinglish:
Ans (b) replace 'offsprings' with 'offspring'
Explanation:- 'offspring' ki singular aur plural form 'offspring' hi rehti hai.

questions.question: Most doctors agree that home quarantine (a)/ proves to be more convenient and effective (b)/ than hospitalize in case (c)/ of a minor viral infection (d).
questions.solutionHinglish:
Ans (c) replace 'hospitalize' with 'hospitalization'
Explanation:- 'home quarantine' noun ka comparison noun 'hospitalization' se hoga.

questions.question: The students were amazed to learn (a)/ about the rotation and revolution (b)/ that are responsible for the earth gravitational changes (c)/ affecting the climate throughout the year (d).
questions.solutionHinglish:
Ans (c) replace 'earth gravitational' with 'earth's gravitational'
Explanation:- 'earth' ka 'gravitational changes' par possession banane ke liye 'earth's gravitational changes' sahi hoga.

questions.question: Aman Sir gave me many useful advices (a)/ that helped me improve my English (b)/ and score better in the examination (c)/ no error (d).
questions.solutionHinglish:
Ans (a) replace 'many useful advices' with 'many pieces of useful advice'
Explanation:- 'advice' uncountable noun hai, isliye 'many pieces of useful advice' likhna padega.

questions.question: Delhi's (a)/ traffic problems (b)/ are increasing rapidly (c)/ due to poor urban planning and rising population. no error (d)
questions.solutionHinglish:
Ans (d) No error
Explanation:- City ke naam ('Delhi's') ke sath apostrophe 's' lagana bilkul sahi hai.

questions.question: The police (a)/ acted quickly (b)/ as there was a strong (c)/ suspect on the new employee (d).
questions.solutionHinglish:
Ans (d) replace 'suspect' with 'suspicion'
Explanation:- 'suspect' ka matlab sandigdh vyakti aur 'suspicion' ka matlab sandeh/shak hota hai. Yahan 'a strong suspicion' sahi hoga.

questions.question: The experts could not (a)/ determine the exact reason (b)/ of the floods that led to (c)/ many casualties in the district (d).
questions.solutionHinglish:
Ans (b) replace 'reason' with 'cause'
Explanation:- Natural events ('floods') ke liye 'the exact cause of the floods' sabse sahi answer hoga.

questions.question: Although his mean (a)/ are not sufficient (b)/ to maintain such a luxurious lifestyle, (c)/ he throws grand parties every month (d).
questions.solutionHinglish:
Ans (a) replace 'mean' with 'means'
Explanation:- Income/resources waale matlab ke liye 'means' ka use hota hai.

questions.question: The comments you made (a)/ during the meeting (b)/ were completely irrelevance (c)/ to the topic under discussion (d).
questions.solutionHinglish:
Ans (c) replace 'irrelevance' with 'irrelevant'
Explanation:- 'were completely' ke baad adjective 'irrelevant' aayega.

questions.question: Shikha got frightened (a)/ when she noticed (b)/ her shade moving (c)/ on the wall behind her (d).
questions.solutionHinglish:
Ans (c) replace 'shade' with 'shadow'
Explanation:- Parchaayi ke liye 'shadow' ka use karte hai.

questions.question: The farmer got worried (a)/ when he saw several mouse (b)/ eating the grains (c)/ stored in his barn (d).
questions.solutionHinglish:
Ans (b) replace 'mouse' with 'mice'
Explanation:- 'several' ke baad 'mouse' ka plural 'mice' aayega.

questions.question: People in different parts of India (a)/ have their own distinct (b)/ habits when it comes to marriages and festivals (c)/ no error (d).
questions.solutionHinglish:
Ans (c) replace 'habits' with 'customs'
Explanation:- Jab koi society/samaaj marriages aur festivals me rivaaz follow karta hai toh usse 'customs' bolte hai.

questions.question: The coach warned the players (a)/ not to lose their tempers (b)/ on the field even if the referee made (c)/ an unfair decision (d).
questions.solutionHinglish:
Ans (b) replace 'tempers' with 'temper'
Explanation:- 'temper' ek uncountable noun hai jiska plural nahi hota.

questions.question: The rescue team (a)/ immediately reached the site (b)/ where several navy personal were trapped (c)/ inside the damaged submarine (d).
questions.solutionHinglish:
Ans (c) replace 'navy personal' with 'navy personnel'
Explanation:- 'personnel' noun hota hai jo staff/officers ko refer karta hai.

questions.question: The publics are demanding (a)/ that the government should withdraw (b)/ the recently introduced education policy (c)/ No error (d).
questions.solutionHinglish:
Ans (a) replace 'publics are' with 'public is/are'
Explanation:- 'public' collective noun hai jiska plural 'publics' nahi ho sakta.

questions.question: Your son's-in-law's (a)/ car broke down on the highway (b)/ while he was travelling (c)/ to Delhi for an official meeting (d).
questions.solutionHinglish:
Ans (a) replace 'son's-in-law's car' with 'son-in-law's car'
Explanation:- Compound noun 'son-in-law' pe possession banane ke liye apostrophe 's' sirf 'law' pe hoga.

questions.question: The committee conducted a nationwide poll (a)/ to understand the (b)/ public's opinion (c)/ on the recently proposed education reforms (d).
questions.solutionHinglish:
Ans (c) replace 'public's opinion' with 'public opinion'
Explanation:- 'public opinion' ek compound noun mana jata hai jiske sath apostrophe 's' ki jarurat nahi hoti.

questions.question: Among the main factors (a)/ responsible for his resignation (b)/ were the long working hours, constant travel (c)/ and desiring to start his own business (d).
questions.solutionHinglish:
Ans (d) replace 'desiring' with 'the desire'
Explanation:- Parallelism follow karne ke liye 'desiring' gerund ki jagah 'the desire' noun aayega.

questions.question: The professor explained that (a)/ human society, like language, (b)/ is divided into multiple stratums (c)/ based on culture and education (d).
questions.solutionHinglish:
Ans (c) replace 'stratums' with 'strata'
Explanation:- 'stratum' ka plural 'strata' hota hai.

questions.question: Gifts and sweets were distributed (a)/ among the childrens (b)/ on the occasion of the annual function of the school (c)/ No error (d).
questions.solutionHinglish:
Ans (b) replace 'childrens' with 'children'
Explanation:- 'child' ka plural 'children' hota hai jiske sath 's' ka use nahi hota.

questions.question: The manager appreciated (a)/ your dedication towards work (b)/ but said that your friends attitude (c)/ towards deadlines needs improvement (d).
questions.solutionHinglish:
Ans (c) replace 'friends' with 'friend's/friends''
Explanation:- 'friend ka attitude' dikhane ke liye apostrophe ('s) ka use hoga ('friend's attitude').

questions.question: Her visitings to the office (a)/ have become irregular these days (b)/ as she is working on several field projects (c)/ in different parts of the country (d).
questions.solutionHinglish:
Ans (a) replace 'visitings' with 'visits'
Explanation:- Plural noun 'visits' sabse sahi answer hoga.

questions.question: Many cattles have been reported missing (a)/ from the nearby villages (b)/ due to the heavy rains (c)/ and broken fences (d).
questions.solutionHinglish:
Ans (a) replace 'cattles' with 'cattle'
Explanation:- 'cattle' pehle se hee plural noun hai aur isme 's' lagane ki jarurat nahi hai.

questions.question: The teacher provided (a)/ all the necessary informations (b)/ about the upcoming examination (c)/ to the students during the meeting (d).
questions.solutionHinglish:
Ans (b) replace 'informations' with 'information'
Explanation:- 'information' ek uncountable noun hai jiska plural nahi hota.

questions.question: The committee is responsible for (a)/ organizing the annual event (b)/ and prepare the list of guest speakers (c)/ before the deadline (d).
questions.solutionHinglish:
Ans (c) replace 'prepare' with 'preparing'
Explanation:- Parallelism ke according 'organizing' ke sath 'and preparing' gerund aayega.

questions.question: Everyone gathered near the riverbank (a)/ to watch such a magnificent spectacles (b)/ created by the colorful lights (c)/ and the flowing water (d).
questions.solutionHinglish:
Ans (b) replace 'spectacles' with 'spectacle'
Explanation:- Yahan 'spectacle' ka matlab 'drishya/nazara' hai aur 'a' article ke sath singular 'spectacle' aayega.

questions.question: As the bridge was getting repaired (a)/ the villagers had no alternate (b)/ but to take the longer route (c)/ through the dense forest to reach the market (d).
questions.solutionHinglish:
Ans (b) replace 'alternate' with 'alternative'
Explanation:- 'alternative' noun hota hai jiska matlab 'doosra vikalp/option' hota hai.

questions.question: Because of multiple server issues, (a)/ he could solve only (b)/ three-fourth of the questions in the exam(c)/ No error (d).
questions.solutionHinglish:
Ans (c) replace 'three-fourth' with 'three-fourths'
Explanation:- Fractions me numerator 1 se bada ho toh denominator me 's' aata hai ('three-fourths').

questions.question: The teacher said (a)/ it would take around (b)/ one and a half month (c)/ to finish the syllabus (d).
questions.solutionHinglish:
Ans (c) replace 'half month' with 'half months'
Explanation:- 'one and a half' ke sath plural noun 'months' aayega.

questions.question: The committee decided (a)/ to donate the proceed of the charity event (b)/ to the families affected by the recent floods (c)/ in the northern region (d).
questions.solutionHinglish:
Ans (b) replace 'proceed' with 'proceeds'
Explanation:- Event se collect hue amount ke liye plural noun 'proceeds' aata hai.

questions.question: My cousin's manager's car (a)/ broke down (b)/ on the highway (c)/ while he was returning from his office (d).
questions.solutionHinglish:
Ans (a) replace 'My cousin's manager's car' with 'The car of my cousin's manager'
Explanation:- Do apostrophe 's' lagatar sath mein use nahi karte, isliye 'The car of my cousin's manager' sahi hoga.

questions.question: The district court (a)/ has already issued three summons (b)/ to the director of the company, (c)/ but he did not appear before the court (d).
questions.solutionHinglish:
Ans (b) replace 'summons' with 'summonses'
Explanation:- 'three' ke sath 'summons' ka plural 'summonses' aayega.

questions.question: She could not (a)/ remember (b)/ my time of arrival (c)/ when the police asked her about it (d).
questions.solutionHinglish:
Ans (c) replace 'my time of arrival' with 'the time of my arrival'
Explanation:- Possession 'arrival' par banana hai na ki 'time' par, isliye 'the time of my arrival' sahi phrase hai.

questions.question: The various facilities of the hotel (a)/ along with its excellent service (b)/ and peaceful environment makes (c)/ it one of the best resorts in the region (d).
questions.solutionHinglish:
Ans (c) replace 'makes' with 'make'
Explanation:- Main subject 'The various facilities' plural hai, isliye plural verb 'make' aayegi.

questions.question: She (a)/bought two breads (b)/ from the (c)/ bakery this morning. (d)
questions.solutionHinglish:
Ans (b) replace 'two breads' with 'two loaves of bread'
Explanation:- 'bread' ek uncountable noun hai, isliye 'two loaves of bread' sabse sahi answer hoga.

questions.question: The handwriting of the teacher (a)/ as well as the students (b)/ was appreciated by the principal (c)/ during the meeting. (d)
questions.solutionHinglish:
Ans (b) replace 'the students' with 'that of the students / the student's / the students''
Explanation:- Teacher ki handwriting ke sath students ki handwriting ka possession dikhane ke liye 'the students'' (apostrophe) ka use karenge.

questions.question: The principal appreciated (a)/ Ravi's and Kiran's (b)/ duet that they sang in (c)/ the annual function. (d)
questions.solutionHinglish:
Ans (b) replace 'Ravi's' with 'Ravi'
Explanation:- Joint possession ('duet') dikhane ke liye sirf last waale noun pe apostrophe 's' lagta hai ('Ravi and Kiran's duet').

questions.question: The government's main goal under the new welfare policy is to enhance people's daily lifestyles by providing better housing, education, and employment opportunities.
questions.solutionHinglish:
Ans (b)
Explanation:- Better housing, education and employment opportunities ke liye 'living standards' term ka use karte hai.

questions.question: When the flood blocked all roads and vehicles stopped moving, villagers had no option but to reach the nearby shelter by walk through the muddy fields.
questions.solutionHinglish:
Ans (c)
Explanation:- Paidal jaane ke liye 'on foot' sabse sahi idiom/term hai.

questions.question: In ancient civilizations, natural disasters like floods and earthquakes were often considered as God's revenge for people's sins, leading to mass prayers and sacrifices to please the deities.
questions.solutionHinglish:
Ans (b)
Explanation:- 'revenge for people's sins' ke liye sahi phrase 'punishment for wrongdoings' (option B) hoga.

questions.question: After several requests, the students finally received a permission from the principal to organize the annual cultural festival.
questions.solutionHinglish:
Ans (c)
Explanation:- 'permission' ek uncountable noun hai jiske sath 'a/an' article ka use nahi hota, isliye 'received permission' (option C) sahi hai.

questions.question: Although the project report was well prepared and neatly presented, there is still some space for correction before we submit it to the board.
questions.solutionHinglish:
Ans (b)
Explanation:- Sudhaar ki gunjaish ke liye 'some room for improvement' (option B) phrase ka use kiya jaata hai.

questions.question: The students could not go out to play because they had many homeworks to complete before Monday morning.
questions.solutionHinglish:
Ans (b)
Explanation:- 'homework' ek uncountable noun hai, isliye 'a lot of homework' (option B) sabse sahi answer hoga.

questions.question: After the meeting was over, the manager said that no other informations was conveyed to him regarding the new policy changes.
questions.solutionHinglish:
Ans (c)
Explanation:- 'information' uncountable noun hai jiska plural nahi ho sakta, isliye 'No other information' (option C) sahi hai.

questions.question: A frightened man called the police when a swarm of dogs started chasing him on the main road.
questions.solutionHinglish:
Ans (a)
Explanation:- Kutton ke jhund ke liye 'pack of' collective noun ka use hota hai.

questions.question: The researchers announced that India has successfully developed a nose-based vaccine to provide stronger immunity against the new Covid variant.
questions.solutionHinglish:
Ans (b)
Explanation:- Nose ke through di jaane wali vaccine ke liye 'a nasal vaccine' (option B) sahi term hai.

questions.question: These days, I avoid junk food completely and prefer homemade meals and green smoothies since I've become more conscious of my healthfulness.
questions.solutionHinglish:
Ans (b)
Explanation:- 'my' possessive adjective ke baad 'health' noun (option B) sabse sahi answer hoga.

questions.question: While on a safari in Africa, we were thrilled to see a group of lions resting under a large acacia tree.
questions.solutionHinglish:
Ans (a)
Explanation:- Lions ke group ke liye 'a pride of lions' (option A) collective noun ka use hota hai.

questions.question: Ramesh started learning computer programming at a very early age of ten years old and soon became skilled in coding.
options: (a) a very early age of ten
(b) the very early age of ten years
(c) a very early age of ten years
questions.solutionHinglish:
Ans (a)
Explanation:- 'age' ke sath dobara 'years old' likhna superfluous hai, isliye 'a very early age of ten' (option A) sabse sahi answer hoga.

questions.question: The tailor handed over my new trouser yesterday, but I found the fitting slightly loose at the waist.
questions.solutionHinglish:
Ans (d)
Explanation:- 'trousers' ek pair noun hai jise plural mein likhte hai, isliye 'pair of trousers' (option D) sabse sahi answer hoga.

questions.question: She purchased three dozens eggs from the market.
questions.solutionHinglish:
Ans (c)
Explanation:- 'eggs' se pehle 'three dozen' adjective hai jiska plural nahi hota, isliye 'three dozen eggs' (option C) sabse sahi answer hoga.

questions.question: It was (a)/ the very well-directed film (b)/ and we enjoyed it.(c)/ no error (d)
questions.solutionHinglish:
Ans (b) use 'a' instead of 'the'
